The Synopsis 

The Indian Health Service, Navajo Area, Crownpoint Service Unit located at Crownpoint N.M. 87313 has an upcoming requirement for Office Chairs and Tables. 30 Days ARO.

The North American Industry Classification System or NAICS code is 337214- Office Furniture (except Wood) Manufacturing with a small business size standard of 1,100 Employees. 

The Request for Quotations No. IHS1522559 in accordance with 12.201-1 will be issued on or by February 26, 2026.  Evaluation factors may include Lowest price.  Quotes will be due on or by March 5, 2026 at 8:00am MST. The acquisition is an Indian Owned, Small Business Economic Enterprises set aside.

In accordance with 52.204-7 the offeror shall have an active Federal Government contracts registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) when submitting an offer or quotation in response to this solicitation and at the time of award.

For additional information, contact Arlynda Largo, Purchasing Agent. Email: Arlynda.largo@ihs.gov

THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION.
